note: Replaces Aquae Sulis: the monumental Roman sanctuary postdates AD 1; the pre-Roman spring cult supplies a conservative field label.
Replaces Deva Victrix: the legionary fortress was built in AD 78-86; Deva is retained only as a conservative Brittonic hydronym-derived proxy.
Replaces Colonia Agrippinensis: Cologne did not receive its colonia foundation and Agrippina title until about AD 50.
Replaces Lindum Colonia: the colonia was a later civilian development; Lindum is retained as the conservative inherited toponym.
Replaces Londinium: the Roman city was founded about AD 48 on an uninhabited site; Caesar's attested Thames hydronym is used as a field proxy.
